fixture.weights: random, seed 2026; not a trained model

protocol.endpoint: POST /v1/completions via FastAPI TestClient and the native backend
protocol.sampling: greedy seed 0, then temperature 1.0 with top_p 1.0 and 0.9 for seeds 1-10
protocol.length_check: length-limited text is re-encoded and replayed through a fresh constraint; every byte must be grammar-accepted
protocol.stream_check: every 3th request repeated with stream=true; text and finish_reason must match
protocol.chat_and_tools: the fixture has no chat template; tool schemas are evaluated through the same tool_response_format translation used by chat

unsupported_rejections.message: Supported string formats are email and uuid
False schema has no valid output

scope: constraint enforcement on random weights; not semantic accuracy, trained-model finish rates, or production latency
